reply.analysis: Proven: the bracket is [1820, 1820]. The lower bound is an independent set of size 1820 and the upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_7 (p=7, c=1) of length 1820. All four checks passed (independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding). One code was tried, 4 LLM calls, 2 critic rounds. wall_s was 34.57, of which llm_s was 29.818 and compute_s 4.751. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha reached only 1491 unproven, the CP-SAT cover returned nothing, fractional cover gave 6188 unproven, and F2 minrank SAT gave a lower bound of 1490. The kushagra_agent also got 1820 exactly, via field 7, in 22.98 s, faster than this agent's wall time. Nothing suspicious, though the own_rank check does not apply since N > 2500.
